sloka: मुद्गरैः पट्टिशैः शूलैः प्रासतोमरशक्तिभिः ।परिवार्य हनूमन्तं सहसा तस्थुरग्रतः ।। ५.४२.२९।।।।
transliteration: mudgaraiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ śūlaiḥ prāsatomaraśaktibhiḥ ।parivārya hanūmantaṁ sahasā tasthuragrataḥ ।। 5.42.29।।।।

translations.english: They quickly surrounded Hanuman and stood with hammers, sharpedged spears, tridents, barbed missiles and powerful javelins.
